title: Quotient Rule with Secant and Tangent
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

steps.title: Apply Quotient Rule
steps.mathExpression: y' = \frac{\frac{d}{dx}[\sec x](1 + \tan x) - \sec x \frac{d}{dx}[1 + \tan x]}{(1 + \tan x)^2}
steps.explanation: Set up the quotient rule formula.

steps.title: Substitute Derivatives and Factor
steps.mathExpression: \frac{(\sec x \tan x)(1 + \tan x) - \sec x(\sec^2 x)}{(1 + \tan x)^2} = \frac{\sec x [\tan x + \tan^2 x - \sec^2 x]}{(1 + \tan x)^2}
steps.explanation: Factor out sec(x) from both terms in the numerator.

steps.title: Use Pythagorean Identity tan^2(x) - sec^2(x) = -1
steps.mathExpression: \tan^2 x - \sec^2 x = -1 \implies y' = \frac{\sec x (\tan x - 1)}{(1 + \tan x)^2}
